methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 11 smart sprinkler and hose-timer controllers across major residential brands (Rachio, Rain Bird, Orbit, Hunter, RainMachine, Netro, Wyze, Moen, Skydrop). Prices and specs re-verified 2026-06-20 against manufacturer pages/official stores and corroborated with major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Amazon, Sprinkler Warehouse) and review outlets (TechHive, Reviewed). Adversarial corrections this pass: (1) Rachio 3 (both 8- and 16-zone) HomeKit removed - Rachio publicly abandoned HomeKit in Oct 2022 ('No Response' errors), refunded buyers, and the current rachio.com pages no longer list HomeKit; works_with_homekit set false. (2) Rain Bird ST8I-2.0 price corrected from a third-party (Shell Lumber) markup to the official Rain Bird store price. (3) RainMachine Touch HD-12 release year corrected 2015->2016 (HD-12/HD-16 first in stock 2016 per RainMachine). (4) Moen 8-zone re-rated from 'outdoor rated' to indoor-mount with a -4F..104F operating range and optional outdoor enclosure (Home Depot lists it as Indoor). (5) Skydrop Arc: dead skydrop.com source replaced with the PR Newswire announcement; epa_watersense and works_with_alexa_google downgraded to null because the primary press release only attributes WaterSense to the flagship Halo (not the Arc) and does not confirm native voice-assistant support. Boolean true = feature confirmed present; false = confirmed absent; null = could not be corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Rachio 3 Smart Sprinkler Controller (8-Zone)
products.provenance: Price $199.99 confirmed on rachio.com product page (lists Alexa, Google Assistant, IFTTT, Alarm.com, SmartThings - no HomeKit). Announced March 2018. HomeKit support, added 2018, was officially DROPPED in October 2022 after unresolved 'No Response' errors (9to5Mac, AppleInsider); current page lists no HomeKit, so works_with_homekit set false. WaterSense certification confirmed via utility rebate stores. Default indoor; weatherproof enclosure sold separately for outdoor use.

products.name: Rachio 3 Smart Sprinkler Controller (16-Zone)
products.provenance: Price $249.99 confirmed on rachio.com product page; same 2018 generation and feature set as the 8-zone model. Alexa and Google confirmed on the page; HomeKit set false because Rachio dropped HomeKit in October 2022 (9to5Mac/AppleInsider) and the current page lists no HomeKit. WaterSense confirmed via rebate/utility sources.

products.name: Rachio Smart Hose Timer (Starter Kit)
products.priceNote: rachio.com starter kit price (1 valve + WiFi Hub) as of 2026-06-20; launch MSRP was $99.99
products.provenance: Announced at CES 2023, shipped March 2023 (9to5Toys, PR Newswire). Current rachio.com price $79.99 (launch MSRP $99.99). Hose-bib timer, not an in-ground controller; one WiFi Hub supports up to 8 valves (expandable). IP65 valve and 'Works with Alexa & more' confirmed on the page; HomeKit not supported. WaterSense could not be confirmed for the hose timer, left null.

products.name: Rain Bird ST8I-2.0 Smart Indoor WiFi Irrigation Timer
products.priceNote: Current price on store.rainbird.com (list price $199.23) as of 2026-06-20
products.provenance: Price corrected from $210.09 (Shell Lumber third-party markup) to $169.00 - the current price on the official Rain Bird store (list price $199.23). WaterSense Certified and Alexa per Amazon listing title; Google Assistant confirmed via review sources; HomeKit not supported. Indoor-only model; outdoor variant is ST8O-2.0. Release year ~2019 (2.0 refresh of the 2016/2017 ST8I-WIFI).

products.name: Orbit B-hyve XR Smart Sprinkler Controller (8-Zone)
products.provenance: All fields re-verified on orbitonline.com: price $169.99, indoor/outdoor (engineered for exposure to the elements), EPA WaterSense labeled, integrates with Google and Alexa, expandable to 16 zones/stations. HomeKit not listed. No corrections needed.

products.name: Hunter Hydrawise Pro-C HPC-400 WiFi Controller (4-Zone)
products.priceNote: Per-unit price at Big Irrigation (2023 model listing) as of 2026-06-20
products.provenance: Price $200.33 at Big Irrigation. 4-zone base expandable to 32 via PCM modules. Hydrawise supports BOTH Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant (Hunter Industries integration pages), so works_with_alexa_google stays true (draft provenance wrongly said Google not mentioned). HomeKit not supported. WaterSense confirmed in product descriptions.

products.name: RainMachine Touch HD-12 Smart WiFi Irrigation Controller
products.priceNote: Discontinued per manufacturer; no published current MSRP; secondary market only
products.provenance: Confirmed DISCONTINUED on rainmachine.com (page shows 'DISCONTINUED', price '-'). Release year corrected 2015->2016: the Touch HD-12/HD-16 first went in stock in 2016 (RainMachine store/blog). 12 zones (11 with master valve) confirmed on the page. HomeKit confirmed (Siri voice control on product page; beta added 2019). Alexa via IFTTT. WaterSense (EPA) confirmed. Cloud-independent operation. priceUsd null (no current MSRP).

products.name: Netro Sprite Smart Sprinkler Controller (6-Zone)

specs.indoor_outdoor_rating: indoor only (optional outdoor enclosure sold separately)

products.provenance: Price $99.00 (6-zone) confirmed; 12-zone is $129.00. EPA WaterSense certified (cited as the cheapest WaterSense-certified controller). Compatible with Alexa AND Google Home/IFTTT, so works_with_alexa_google true. HomeKit not supported. Indoor-only; outdoor enclosure sold separately. Release year not corroborated, left null.

products.name: Wyze Sprinkler Controller (8-Zone)
products.priceNote: Price on wyze.com (controller only) as of 2026-06-20
products.provenance: Price $59.99 confirmed on wyze.com (controller only; original 2020/2021 launch was ~$50). Announced Nov 2020, shipped Jan 2021. NO Alexa/Google support per Wyze FAQ ('None at this time'), so works_with_alexa_google false. HomeKit not supported. WaterSense (EPA) marketed via Sprinkler Plus weather-based scheduling and listed by retailers as WaterSense; kept true. Indoor only. Note: the TechHive URL contains a literal 'teview' typo but resolves to the real review.

products.name: Moen Smart Sprinkler Controller (8-Zone)

specs.indoor_outdoor_rating: indoor mount; -4F to 104F operating range; outdoor enclosure available

products.provenance: Price $179.99 confirmed on shop.moen.com. Unveiled at CES 2023, released early 2023. Amazon and Google smart speaker/assistant functionality confirmed on the page; HomeKit not mentioned. EPA WaterSense confirmed (Moen markets it as WaterSense-rated). Rating downgraded from 'outdoor rated' to indoor-mount with a -4F..104F operating range and optional outdoor enclosure: Home Depot/Moen list it as an Indoor controller; the -4..104F figure is an operating-temperature spec, not a weatherproof rating. 16-zone variant (WICNT016G1USA) also exists.

products.name: Skydrop Arc Smart Sprinkler Controller (12-Zone)
products.priceNote: Discontinued; no published retail MSRP; secondary market only (e.g. open-box units listed ~$40)
products.provenance: Source switched to the PR Newswire announcement because skydrop.com is defunct (arc-pr and product pages return blank). Press release confirms 12 zones, Aug 9 2017 launch, WiFi Direct, builder/integrator channel. WaterSense set null: the press release attributes WaterSense ONLY to the flagship Halo, not the Arc (a guess corrected to null). works_with_alexa_google set null: the primary source does not confirm native voice-assistant support (secondary sources claim it, but unverified at primary level). HomeKit null (some sources only via IFTTT, not native). Indoor/outdoor rating not confirmed, null. No retail MSRP, null.
